notes.title: SteamWorld Dig is free on Steam for the next couple of days? Ah, go on then
notes.notes:
Chances are if you like the SteamWorld series that this won't matter very much to you, but for those of you (like me) who've never touched a single game, here's something neat: SteamWorld Dig is completely free on Steam right now. That's free to keep forever, to be clear, not one of those free weekend types of deals. It's not free for that long, mind, only from now until June 26th, and I can't give you a specific time on that day, so if you're remotely interested you might as well just add it to your library.

Read more

notes.title: Pixel mining sim Steamworld Dig is free to keep right now, but act fast
notes.notes:
Indie darling SteamWorld Dig is coming up on its 12th anniversary this August, but the metroidvania mining game is just as good as it was over a decade ago. If you're yet to add it to your library, now's the perfect time to do so, as SteamWorld Dig is free to keep on Steam - but not for long! You have until Thursday, June 26 to add SteamWorld Dig to your Steam library if you want to start your underground adventures in Tumbleton at no cost.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: STEAMWORLD DIG 10TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION!
notes.notes:
SteamWorld Dig is turning a whopping 10 years old this month! 

It was created in 2013 by the wonderful folks over at Image & Form and it received favourable reviews, including 9.5 out of 10 from IGN, 9 out of 10 from Nintendo World Report who said [i]"SteamWorld Dig is a fresh game for the Nintendo eShop and one of the best digital games available on Nintendo's 3D handheld."[/i] and 10 out of 10 from Pocket Gamer with glowing praise [i]"SteamWorld Dig is an utterly phenomenal video game, with layer upon layer of remarkable gameplay to be found."[/i] 

SteamWorld Dig was also nominated for IGN's Black Beta Select Awards in 2013 and was featured as one of Eurogamer readers' Top 50 Games. 

Since 2013 the SteamWorld franchise has grown and we now have a dedicated community of followers, not just on Dig but on our other SteamWorld games too. We enjoy hearing from you all, so to help celebrate such an amazing milestone, we'd love you to leave a message for the SteamWorld Dig team. 

[b][url=https://forms.gle/CaKV4ZCij9vKfiTF8]LEAVE A MESSAGE[/url] [/b]

All messages will be collected and shared - leaving your name is optional. 

Thank you for being a valued member of the SteamWorld Community.

notes.title: Mark Hamill To Host ‘Thunderful World’ Digital Showcase on November 10th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/892bc383a39eb0b46c5b4b09af85c4f9f1be9298.jpg[/img]

Hey friends,

we have some awesome news, which we can finally share with you today: We - that's Thunderful Games - welcome all of you to the premiere of our very first digital games showcase ‘[b]Thunderful World[/b]’! ːsteamhappyː

Find out more in the following press release:


[i][b]Gothenburg, Sweden - October 28th, 2021[/b] - International developer and publisher Thunderful Games, creator of the multi-award winning and multi-million selling SteamWorld franchise, is welcoming everyone to a new digital games showcase, ‘[b]Thunderful World[/b]’. The event will be taking place on [b]November 10th at 11am PT / 2pm ET / 7pm GMT / 8pm CET[/b], hosted by Hollywood and pop culture icon [b]Mark Hamill[/b]. Tune in to the livestream on Twitch, YouTube and the [url=https://thunderful.world/][b]thunderful.world[/b][/url] website.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/8a01bc9ec10d1ba6e674354314fd34accd1fbb51.png[/img]

notes.title: Want more SteamWorld games? You're in luck!
notes.notes:
Howdy, everyone!

I'm Julius, the community manager at Image & Form Games (makers of SteamWorld Dig). Ever since we released SteamWorld Dig, many of you have been asking for more games set in SteamWorld. Today we answer your player prayers!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5355153/d1da9a6cbfaf3811c835469c768b059b8b095f6e.jpg[/img]

We just released [b]SteamWorld Heist[/b], the follow-up to SteamWorld Dig. It's a space adventure set in a post-apocalyptic SteamWorld. You see, a cataclysmic event of earth-shattering proportions has forced the robots out to space! It's a robot-eat-robot world out there and resources are slim. Many steambots have turned to space piracy in order to survive, and you're one of them!

As the captain you will command a steam-driven pirate crew in a series of epic tactical shootouts. Inspired by classics like XCOM and Worms, SteamWorld Heist is turn-based strategy with a twist: You manually aim the guns of your robots, allowing for insane skill shots and bullet-bouncing action!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5355153/d779191769ab08005961178cc701d0fb0bb7014c.png[/img]

[h1]What do players think?[/h1]

If you enjoyed Dig we're sure you'll get drawn in by the atmosphere and gameplay loop offered by SteamWorld Heist. Critics love it, as the game's sitting comfortably at 86/100 on Metacritic. But let's hear it from the Steam user reviews:

"This game is perfect. Literally perfect." – Zaphnod

"Pirate robots in space who live for hats. Awesome." – FartHoofer1227

"Firefly with robots and hats. I like it." – CNN


[h1]Will you give SteamWorld Heist a try?[/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/322190

notes.title: SteamWorld Heist: A Turn-Based Space Robot Roguelite
notes.notes:
One of the most overlooked games of 2013 was Image & Form’s SteamWorld Dig. A total overhaul of the splendid 3DS original, it combined puzzling, exploration, a dash of Spelunky, and the all important mining, to create a Metroidvania that I merrily completed a second time over for its PC version. So it’s with a keen ear that I hear news of their next game: SteamWorld Heist. However, despite the shared title, this is a whole other game – a space-themed, turn-based, survival game, scavenging a dead world with a team of rusty robots. Many more details, and a brief teaser trailer below.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: SteamWorld Dig is 50% off on Steam + Release of Official Soundtrack

Howdy, diggers! From today at 09:00 am PDT until this Sunday we're slashing the price of SteamWorld Dig on Steam in HALF. That means you can get your hands on SteamWorld Dig for PC, Mac and Linux for $4.99 (or the equivalent).

notes.title: Version 1.07 live
notes.notes:
We just released version 1.07! The main changes include a control binding screen, new options menu, generally improved compatibility and bug fixes.

[b]Version 1.07[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new options menu with input binding screen.
[*] Added support for a few more gamepads
[*] Added fallback to GL_EXT_framebuffer_object in case GL_ARB_framebuffer_object was not supported.
[*] Added an error message when failing to load a texture instead of hard crashing.
[*] Added Screen.FullscreenSize setting which if set will force real fullscreen mode with resolution change (not exposed through UI).
[*] Added Audio.OutputDevice setting which lets you specify output device (not exposed through UI).
[*] Improved behaviors with multiple displays in Linux somewhat.
[*] Fixed Escape key not working to skip logos screen.
[*] Fixed so that all settings appear in settings.xml, even when being default values.
[*] Replaced OpenAL with OpenAL Soft on Windows.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.03 out now!
notes.notes:
We've released an initial patch containing a number of fixes and improvements. Big thanks to the pre-release testers for reporting these issues!

Here is the change log:

[b]Version 1.03[/b]
[list][*] Listed more controls on the pause screen.
   [*] Added smarter gamepad detection. If you play on keyboard, you now get keyboard button indicators even if you have a gamepad attached to your computer.
   [*] Fixed crash when playing the game in French.
   [*] Fixed input issues that made wall-jumping difficult.
   [*] Fixed tools not being selected after buying them in some cases.
   [*] Fixed some buggy achievements.
   [*] Fixed mismatching background tiles.
   [*] Fixed a number of misc issues.
[/list]
